## What changes for users

## Checklist

- [ ] This changes an existing blueprint: a bug fix, a feature or documentation ([what is welcome](https://github.com/mxstzdev/ha-blueprints/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#what-contributions-are-welcome))
- [ ] Blueprint inputs have user-friendly names and descriptions
- [ ] The blueprint's README.md is updated (features, options, FAQ)
- [ ] Tests cover the change (`./scripts/validate.sh` passes)
- [ ] Developer comments explain non-obvious template logic
